description.value: Palliser Lodge is a ski-in/ski-out condo-hotel nestled in the glades at Kicking Horse Mountain Resort, steps from the mountain village in Golden, BC. It offers guest rooms and one- or two-bedroom condo suites with full kitchens, electric fireplaces, private balconies, and private hot tubs in select units. Golden sits at the intersection of several major cycling routes and is a gateway to Yoho, Glacier, and Banff national parks, making this a potential base for touring cyclists.
